name: mcpResource
description: Builds a resource MCP content block. The resource argument is the embedded resource content (typically a struct with a uri and the resource payload). The block passes through the automatic result coercion untouched, so use it when a tool wants exact control over what the client renders.

params.name: resource
params.description: The embedded resource, usually a struct describing the resource's uri and content.

links.title: RustCFML MCP documentation
links.description: Content helpers for exact control over MCP responses.

examples.title: Return an embedded resource
examples.description: Embed a resource directly in a tool response.
